_comment: The assistant role ships no default responsibilities. A duty one deployment gives one assistant — a weekly briefing built from ITS meetings, folders and people — is that agent's own responsibility: it lives in the agent's responsibility store (Firestore primes/{prime}/fleet/{agent}/responsibilities) and changes with responsibility-manage, live within a minute, with no release and no upgrade (C-29, C-36). It never ships in this file (C-28). A default that every assistant in every deployment should run belongs here.
